snippet.title: Something is Inside Your House...
snippet.description:
Something is Inside Your House...

And it's something horrifying.

Verity's voice actor (did an even GREATER job than part 1): @JustWhispy 
Friend in the video: @Twixxel_lesgo 

My Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/033vHZW7F2GVDiC44bHwfj

This is part 2 of the Minecraft Verity Series:
Something I trusted has been here longer than I knew. Every exit leads back home. Every village is empty. And the friend I brought to help me disappeared without a sound, while he just kept smiling.

NO,  you CANNOT repost dubbed versions of my videos. If you dubbed them, email me and I might add it as an official audio track.

Intro - 0:00 - 0:26

snippet.title: ICE CITY | EPISODE 2
snippet.description:
ICE CITY | Official Trailer

Set against the backdrop of modern London culture, Ice City explores friendship, pressure, street politics, family, and the choices people make when they are trying to rise above their circumstances.

What starts as ambition soon becomes a test of loyalty, as each character is forced to decide who they really are, who they can trust, and how far they are willing to go.

Raw, stylish, and character-driven, Ice City captures the energy of London youth culture through sharp dialogue, music, fashion, humour, and tension. It is not just about conflict, but about identity, brotherhood, legacy, and the cost of chasing power in a city that does not give second chances.

Subscribe to the channel and turn on notifications so you do not miss the release.

snippet.title: The Total War 40K Trailer Revealed WAY More Than I Realised
snippet.description:
The new Total War: Warhammer 40,000 trailer might have revealed WAY more gameplay mechanics than people realised. After analysing the footage frame by frame, extracting unit cards, UI elements and battle screens, it looks like Creative Assembly could be building one of the most ambitious Total War games ever made.

From morale systems and battlefield momentum to strategic reserves, reinforcement mechanics, cover systems, suppression, hidden visibility mechanics and even possible command structures, there’s a ridiculous amount of hidden information packed into this trailer.

The more you dig into this trailer, the more it feels like Creative Assembly isn’t just making “Total War with boltguns.” This could be a massive evolution of the Total War formula built specifically for the scale and chaos of Warhammer 40K.

Let me know what hidden details you spotted in the trailer and what mechanics you think Creative Assembly is cooking up.

#TotalWarWarhammer40K

Step one, you say, "We need to talk"
He walks, you say, "Sit down, it's just a talk"
He smiles politely back at you
You stare politely right on through
Some sort of window to your right
As he goes left and you stay right
Between the lines of fear and blame
You begin to wonder why you came

Where did I go wrong? I lost a friend
Somewhere along in the bitterness
And I would have stayed up with you all night

You lower yours and grant him one last choice
Drive until you lose the road

snippet.title: The Cranberries - Scenes From 'Linger' (The Only Color Reel)
snippet.description:
Scenes from 'Linger' / (The Only Color Reel) by The Cranberries

Directed by Melodie McDaniel in 1993, "Linger" was filmed almost entirely on 16mm black-and-white film, a deliberate aesthetic choice inspired by Jean-Luc Godard's 1965 noir film Alphaville. But one reel was shot in color. A brief moment from it appeared in the original music video, desaturated and lasting under 15 seconds. This is the full scene from that reel: every take, in color, restored from the original 16mm and presented in 4K for the first time.

Designed to give fans a deeper connection to the band's legacy, the "Scenes From" series strips away the traditional music video edit to present raw, 4K performance takes restored from the original film sources.

Website: https://www.paulheaton.co.uk/

Lyrics

I saw you tie your shoe laces
You looked so very pleased
They came undone immediately
You sank down on your knees

Later at the light bulb change
It took you several hours
I watched you punch the air in joy
I thought the future’s ours

North Korea on holiday
Beirut for a midweek break
We could go just anywhere
And make the most of our mistake

And if the sun don’t shine
Well the boy’s still mine
Like a right foot in left shoe
My favourite kind of idiot
Is you, you, you
You’re a little bit cute
But you ain’t no beaut
But I don’t date you for the view
My favourite kind of idiot is you

I saw you try to cross the road
In a fight that you still lose
Both cycle lane and bus lane
Still leaving you confused

Returning half hour later
You still looked pretty lost
Finally reached the other side
But forgotten why you’d crossed

New York, London, Milan, Paris
None of them we’ve been
Just a one day trip to the council tip
Fulfils our every dream

I can’t believe the things we do
When just left on our own
But madness and insanity
Furnished both our homes
You’re my dream idiot
I hope I’m your dream fool
Nevermind the law
Or security door
If you weren’t meant to break the rules

#PaulHeaton #FavouriteKindofIdiot #Jenius

Is you, you, you

My favourite kind of idiot is you

In a fight that you still lose
Both cycle lane and bus lane
Still leaving you confused

Returning half hour later
You still looked pretty lost
Finally reached the other side
But forgotten why you’d crossed

New York, London, Milan, Paris
None of them we’ve been
Just a one day trip to the council tip
Fulfils our every dream

I can’t believe the things we do
When just left on our own
But madness and insanity
Furnished both our homes
You’re my dream idiot
I hope I’m your dream fool
Nevermind the law
Or security door
If you weren’t meant to break the rules

snippet.title: Firearms Expert Reacts to Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Guns | EXP
snippet.description:
EXP is the premium destination for your favourite expert-driven content, all funded by the fans. Get early access and extended episodes every week at: https://Patreon.com/WatchEXP

EXP Merch is available now! Go to https://expvideo.info to check out our Cursed and Core Collection, including T-Shirts, Hoodies, Pint Glasses, Posters, and Stickers! 

Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the the weapons of Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, including the AK-inspired Volk Rifle, an energy rifle that transforms into a pair of automatic pistols, and a Railgun because this is sci-fi COD of course...

00:00 - Intro
01:04 - Volk Rifle
04:30 - EMC Energy Pistol
06:09 - Karma-45 SMG
08:19 - KBAR-32 Assault Rifle
11:08 - KBS Longbow Sniper Rifle
14:01 - Type-2 Energy Rifle/Akimbo Auto Pistols
15:59 - DCM-8 Shotgun
18:37 - EBR-800 Sniper/Assault Rifle
21:10 - Widowmaker Sniper Rifle
23:39 - Hailstorm Revolver
26:07 - EM3 Railgun

In this episode of Expert Reacts on EXP, Jonathan Ferguson--an expert in firearms history and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK--breaks down guns of Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, and compares them to their real-life counterparts with artefacts from the Royal Armouries archive.

If you're interested in seeing more of Jonathan's work, you can check out more from the Royal Armouries right here. - https://www.youtube.com/user/RoyalArmouries  

If you would like to support the Royal Armouries, you can make a charitable donation to the museum here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/donate

And if you would like to become a member of the Royal Armouries, you can get a membership here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/become-a-member

You can purchase Jonathan's book here. - https://www.headstamppublishing.com/bullpup-rifle-book

You can subscribe to the Armax Journal that Jonathan Associate Edited here: https://www.armaxjournal.org/

snippet.title: An Additional Look at Resident Evil
snippet.description:
This is a video retrospective and critique of the Resident Evil 4 Remake, Resident Evil 9: Requiem, and a whole huge helping of middle-era Resident Evil titles that fell through the cracks and weren't covered by by larger retrospective from a few years back. The middle era titles are mostly also remakes, lightgun game digests, and other offbeat spinoffs like Dead Aim and Operation Raccoon City. If RE9 is a game about legacy, this analysis seeks to figure out what that legacy really is and what it might actually mean. Spoilers throughout for each review!

Audio Editing by Lita Greene

____TABLE OF CONTENTS____

Intro-- 0:00:00
Resident Evil 4 Remake-- 0:00:13
RE4R Seperate Ways-- 00:47:43
Gun Survivor 2 Code Veronica-- 1:05:15
Dead Aim-- 1:18:00
Umbrella Chronicles-- 1:37:44
Darkside Chronicles-- 2:05:16
Operation Raccoon City-- 2:30:29
Resident Evil 2 Remake Ghost Survivors / 4th Survivor-- 3:05:27
Resident Evil 8 Shadows of Rose DLC-- 3:18:41
Resident Evil 9 Requiem-- 3:42:29
Credits-- 4:47:50
